summary: Frontend-only regression for 3 targeted nav+footer bugs. All three fixes verified precisely: (1) entrance fade+slide animation confirmed via computed style sampling — opacity 0→1 and translateY -8→0 with x=-50% preserved (matrix -960 kept) over ~500ms visible transition; (2) scrolled pill state is perfectly horizontally centered on 1920px viewport (centerDelta = 0px, well within the 2px tolerance) with top=16, width=1120, borderRadius=100px, backdrop-blur(12px), pink box-shadow; (3) reverse scroll returns to full-width bar (top=0, width=1920, radius=0); (4) footer swap complete — footer now contains with filter brightness(0) invert(1) and no butterfly SVG branding logo. Nav logo loads correctly (naturalWidth=304, renders 160px at top and 132px in pill). Regression flows all pass: login with demo credentials -> dashboard with 4 seeded campaign rows, CSV export triggers download 'titli-80g-Titli-Demo-School-20260812.csv', school registration modal opens with password field (data-testid='school-password-input'). All sections (#how, #schools, #students, #impact) render.
